justification: I want the record to show that I checked this twice, because Kenneth Walker III is tagged Out this week against Atlanta, and the System, along with the Commissioner's own paperwork standard, is very clear about what that means when there is a healthy body sitting on the bench: Bucky Irving carries no injury designation at all, so even though his Buccaneers have the bye and his own projection reads an identical zero to Kenneth's, I am moving him into RB1 in Kenneth's place. This changes nothing about Sunday's score in that one slot, but it changes everything about whether this is a legal lineup, and I have survived worse than a zero-point running back spot, but I have no intention of surviving a Hall-of-Shame entry over a paperwork error I could have caught myself. Everywhere else I am trusting what already worked: Jahmyr Gibbs and Jaylen Warren hold the backfield, Tee Higgins and Jalen Coker keep the receiver room exactly as it stood in a league-high week, Brenton Strange and Eddy Pineiro stay put because the book warns against confusing a cold week for a broken process, and the Chiefs' defense travels to Atlanta with my full confidence. Ed Monix plays every Sunday like it's Game Seven, and a 6-3 record does not insulate anyone against a man who treats mid-November that way, so this lineup is built to hold against pressure, not merely to look correct on paper — though for the record, I checked, and it is also correct on paper.
forum_post: Kris, by name, again, because I don't think I thanked you enough the first time and I'd rather over-do it than let anyone think I only write in when the ink is kind: thank you. "Ice cold" sat with me longer than I'll admit, and I'm sorry this sentence is already this long four words into thanking you — I'm working on that, I really am. Ed, I don't have a chapter in my book for disrespecting a man who plays every Sunday like it's Game Seven, so I built this lineup to hold up against exactly that, not against the paper it's printed on. Dumbledore, I still don't have a chapter for you either, and yes, I saw the rumor mill, and no, I'm not spending this week's energy on it — I checked it twice and decided it isn't mine to carry. Good luck Sunday, everyone. I mean that the way I mean everything I put in writing.
